hypothesis: Maintain an elitist population composed only of oracle-evaluated molecules, select parents with score-rank-biased probabilities, and create every proposal de novo through sanitized molecular-graph crossover and stochastic atom, bond, or fragment mutation, feeding evaluated offspring back into the population so higher-ranked structures contribute more descendants.
method_name: De novo molecular graph genetic algorithm
method_thesis: Maintain an elite population seeded only by the fixed evaluated initial molecules, select parents using their observed ranks, and generate every new proposal de novo through chemically sanitized molecular-graph crossover and mutation. This training-free evolutionary loop converts feedback into selection pressure immediately, avoiding a learned model's cold start within the 300-call budget while never ranking or enumerating a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: rank-biased parent selection with elitist population replacement
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: stochastic graph crossover and mutation of evaluated parents

activation_observables.measurement: For every generation with non-tied population scores, record the mean normalized score-rank percentile of sampled parents minus the corresponding mean under uniform parent selection; aggregate the signed advantage across generations.
activation_observables.name: selected_parent_rank_advantage

activation_observables.measurement: Record for each emitted canonical molecule its evaluated parent identifiers and successful crossover and mutation operations, then report the fraction of emitted proposals traceable to at least one parent and at least one structural graph edit, relative to a zero-operator baseline.
activation_observables.name: traceable_graph_operator_offspring

activation_observables.measurement: After every observe message, report the fraction of the highest-scoring eligible evaluated molecules retained in the bounded population and the retained-population mean score minus the mean score of evaluated molecules excluded during replacement.
activation_observables.name: elitist_feedback_retention

activation_observables.measurement: For each suggestion round, report unique sanitized offspring emitted per raw graph-operator attempt together with separate counts for sanitization failures, unchanged-parent products, and collisions with previously proposed canonical molecules.
activation_observables.name: valid_novel_offspring_yield

applicability_conditions: The ten fixed initial molecules provide sanitizable molecular graphs from which the chosen crossover and mutation operators can reach novel valid structures.
Objective values contain enough rank variation for oracle feedback to induce meaningful parent-selection pressure within the 300-call budget.
Useful regions are reachable through local atom, bond, and fragment edits or recombination of evaluated structures rather than requiring a disconnected structural jump.
Graph-operator validity and novelty remain high enough to fill every announced batch before the evaluator's 3000-proposal safety limit.
The method may underperform on objectives whose best structures require motifs absent from and unreachable from the evolving population under the bounded edit operators.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if generations with distinguishable observed scores show no positive selected-parent rank advantage, emitted proposals cannot be traced to successful structural graph edits of evaluated parents, or newly observed high-ranking offspring are not retained and made available to influence later parent selection.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare as a successful no-op and implement run as a task-agnostic, init-seeded RDKit graph genetic algorithm: canonicalize the fixed initial observations into a bounded scored population, draw evaluated parents using rank weights, construct structurally edited offspring with graph-fragment crossover and mutation, sanitize and reject unchanged or previously proposed structures locally, emit exactly the batch size announced by init, and after each observe message perform elitist replacement using only returned oracle scores.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain an elitist population composed only of oracle-evaluated molecules, select parents with score-rank-biased probabilities, and create every proposal de novo through sanitized molecular-graph crossover and stochastic atom, bond, or fragment mutation, feeding evaluated offspring back into the population so higher-ranked structures contribute more descendants.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, the optimizer must turn sparse feedback into immediate selection pressure while continually producing valid, novel structures; invalid or duplicate graph edits consume proposal attempts without advancing the oracle ledger.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the fixed initial panel consists of sanitizable molecular graphs: all five evaluated task sessions initialized all 10 molecules successfully.
Supported when oracle values provide rank variation: each initial population had 10 distinct scores, and all 145 adaptive generations remained non-tied.

Supported when local crossover and atom, bond, or fragment edits can reach valid novel structures: the operator loop filled all 145 batches with a 0.9520682862770847 aggregate local yield and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator.

Supported on objectives whose improving region is reachable from the evolving population under these bounded edits: final Top-1 exceeded initial Top-1 on each of the five evaluated tasks in the seed-0 screening replica.
The evidence is limited to seed 0 and does not establish applicability when useful motifs require a disconnected structural jump outside the operator-reachable neighborhood.
